pipelineSteps.label: Upload file
pipelineSteps.explanation: A user or operator stages a file for review.

pipelineSteps.label: Identify template/type
pipelineSteps.explanation: The system classifies the file against known input categories.
pipelineSteps.guardrail: Unknown files need mapping before use.

pipelineSteps.label: Parse rows/document sections
pipelineSteps.explanation: Rows, tabs, and document sections are extracted.

pipelineSteps.label: Extract candidate records
pipelineSteps.explanation: Business objects and fields are identified as candidates.

pipelineSteps.label: Normalize fields
pipelineSteps.explanation: Names, dates, statuses, amounts, and IDs are made consistent.

pipelineSteps.label: Validate required fields
pipelineSteps.explanation: Required fields and accepted values are checked.

pipelineSteps.label: Map to known object types
pipelineSteps.explanation: Records are mapped to business object types and layers.
pipelineSteps.guardrail: Unmapped fields are stranded until remediated.

pipelineSteps.label: Attach evidence references
pipelineSteps.explanation: Records keep links back to source files and rows.
pipelineSteps.guardrail: Unsupported claims must not pass through.

pipelineSteps.label: Quarantine bad records
pipelineSteps.explanation: Records with missing, conflicting, or unsafe data are isolated.
pipelineSteps.guardrail: Quarantine is safer than silent acceptance.

pipelineSteps.label: Generate known fact candidates
pipelineSteps.explanation: Validated object attributes become candidate facts.
pipelineSteps.guardrail: Candidate facts are not active facts.

pipelineSteps.label: Generate relationship candidates
pipelineSteps.explanation: Valid object links become candidate relationships.

pipelineSteps.label: Generate insight candidates
pipelineSteps.explanation: Coverage and readiness signals become candidate insights.

pipelineSteps.label: Create inactive candidate version
pipelineSteps.explanation: A complete candidate data version is persisted as inactive metadata.

pipelineSteps.label: Preview
pipelineSteps.explanation: Operators inspect candidate data through explicit preview mode.

pipelineSteps.label: Promote only after approval
pipelineSteps.explanation: Promotion is gated by approval, proof, and rollback readiness.
pipelineSteps.guardrail: Approval is required before active use.

pipelineSteps.label: Roll back if needed
pipelineSteps.explanation: Operators can return to the prior active version after promotion.
pipelineSteps.guardrail: Rollback posture must be known before activation.
